svg.title: A recipe for results
svg.desc: vtkXMLUnstructuredGridReader reads a .vtu; vtkWarpVector moves its points by the displacement, vtkDataSetSurfaceFilter takes the outer faces and vtkPolyDataMapper colours them by stress through a vtkLookupTable, which a vtkScalarBarActor shows too; vtkCutter and vtkContourFilter take the reader's output as branches. Exodus II and CGNS readers give the same data sets as a tree of blocks.

g.text: Exodus II and CGNS readers: the same
data sets, as a tree of blocks
